card.name: Names of restricted-program REMS
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside the brand name of a REMS program, after phrases like 'available only through a restricted program'. It fires on the comma, 'the', or the pieces of the drug name that lead into 'REMS'.

modes.label: Lead-in to program name
modes.description: Comma or 'the' right after 'restricted program' where the REMS program name comes next.
modes.example: TYRUKO is available only under a restricted distribution program,<< the>> TYRUKO REMS Program.

modes.label: Inside the brand name
modes.description: Final pieces of a drug brand name just before the word REMS.
modes.example: ZENBEXUS is available only through a restricted program called ZENBEX<<US>> REMS, because of the risk of

card.writes: It pushes toward the program name continuing as a title (REMS) and away from honorifics like Mr or Mrs.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a drug's restricted-access safety program name is about to be given or finished.
